purpose: Machine-readable rules the runner applies before a finding is accepted. Written per program, in advance, so the automatic validator rejects out-of-scope impacts without a human in the loop.
trusted_roles: pool admin, risk admin, emergency admin
trusted_roles_note: Anything that requires one of these roles to act is out of scope; the runner rejects a PoC whose impact depends on impersonating or re-keying a trusted role.
out_of_scope: known/acknowledged issues and prior audit findings
centralization risks that require a trusted role
gas inefficiency, best-practice and informational issues (not Medium/Low loss)
third-party integrations and tokens not deployed by the program
theoretical issues with no measured on-chain impact at the pinned fork block

severity_caps.note: Only Medium and Low are filed from this task at launch.
severity_caps.funds_at_risk_rule: A finding's severity is the lower of the miner's claim and the measured impact. A finding mapped above Medium is held, not auto-filed, pending an owner decision on the deposit.

severity_by_impact_note: Capped at Medium on purpose for this launch task. When High/Critical tiers are opened (deposit decision), restore the standard mapping in runner/impact.py.
